experiments.boundary_reason: The experiment is explicitly defined by encapsulation of NSGHAsgRNA with Cas9 mRNA in MC3 LNP, intravenous dosing of NSG HemA mice, and subsequent FVIII, coagulation, on-target editing, and off-target measurements. Hydrodynamic injection and plasmid-only findings are distinct preliminary experiments and are excluded.

The source text contains page-column interleaving around some clauses. Only exact, semantically intact quotations were retained where possible.
